Config.Hint.Fido2:
1. Enter the serial number (it becomes the method name FIDO2-<serial>).
2. Plug in the key and click "Start configuration".
3. Windows asks for the key's PIN and a touch.
Config.Hint.FixedTotp:
1. Enter serial number and secret from the manufacturer's seed file.
2. Choose algorithm and time step as printed on the order.
3. The token is created, assigned and activated – nothing to do on the token.
Config.Hint.ProgrammableTotp:
1. Enter the card's serial number and click "Start configuration".
2. A new secret and QR code are shown.
3. Program the card with the vendor's app (NFC) – then hide the secret.
Config.Hint.Tap:
1. Click "Start configuration" – the pass is shown once.
2. Give it to the user ({0} min, {1}); an existing TAP is replaced.
3. The user registers Authenticator or FIDO2 at aka.ms/mysecurityinfo.
Config.Hint.FakeMfa:
1. Registers a TOTP with a random secret – MFA is then always required at sign-in.
2. Without an hrdnr key the secret is discarded: nobody can sign in with it.
3. Use it to block sign-ins until real MFA is set up.

Help.Main.Title: M365 MFA Administration
Help.Main.What: Shows, sets up and deletes the MFA methods of other users – on their behalf, without them having to be present.
Help.Main.Steps:
1. Sign in at the top right with your admin account.
2. Search for a user (name, UPN, email or ID) – or click into the empty search box for recently used users.
3. Check the traffic light and the registered methods on the left.
4. Choose a method on the right and click "Start configuration".
Help.Main.Methods:
• FIDO2 key – phishing-resistant, best for administrators.
• TOTP card (fixed secret) – hardware token from a seed file.
• Programmable TOTP card – you program the secret yourself.
• Temporary Access Pass – one-time code, so the user can register Authenticator or FIDO2 themselves.
• Fake MFA – blocks sign-ins until real MFA exists.
Help.Main.Need: An admin account with Authentication Administrator (or Privileged Authentication Administrator for admins). The method must be enabled in the tenant's authentication methods policy – the tool warns if it is not.
Help.Main.Tools: MFA report (traffic light of all users), TOTP import, token inventory, bulk TAP, bulk offboarding, break-glass account and settings.
Help.Main.Result: Every action is written to the log (bottom right, also as a daily file in Logs). Secrets and passes are only shown, never logged.
Help.Import.Title: Bulk import of TOTP tokens
Help.Import.What: Creates many hardware TOTP tokens at once from the vendor's seed file, assigns them to users and activates them.
Help.Import.When: When a batch of display tokens (key fobs, cards) arrives with a CSV of secrets and serial numbers.
Help.Import.Need: CSV with Secret (Base32) and SerialNumber, optional UPN. Algorithm (SHA-1/SHA-256) and time step (30/60 s) from the order. Hardware OATH tokens must be enabled in the tenant.
Help.Import.Steps:
1. "Sample" saves a template – or "Select CSV …" loads your file.
2. Set algorithm and time step.
3. Tokens without UPN: keep in the inventory or hand them out to a group / CSV list.
4. "Check" validates everything without changing anything.
5. "Import" creates, assigns and activates the green and yellow lines.
Help.Import.Result: Each line shows its status. "Excel export" saves the list serial number → user as hand-out document. "Undo" removes the tokens of the last run again.
Help.Inventory.Title: Token inventory
Help.Inventory.What: Lists all hardware TOTP tokens of the tenant: free (yellow), assigned (blue) and activated (green).
Help.Inventory.When: To hand out spare tokens, replace a lost token or clean up tokens that are no longer used.
Help.Inventory.Need: For "Assign" select a user in the main window first. For activation you need the code currently shown on the token.
Help.Inventory.Steps:
• Assign: free token → selected user, activated with the code on the token.
• Hand out: all free tokens to a group or CSV list, one each – users activate them at aka.ms/mysecurityinfo.
• Activate: assigned token with the code on it.
• Unassign: back to free. Delete: out of the inventory.
Help.Inventory.Result: After "Hand out" the assignment list (serial number → user) is offered as Excel.
Help.BulkTap.Title: Bulk Temporary Access Pass
Help.BulkTap.What: Creates a Temporary Access Pass for many users at once.
Help.BulkTap.When: Onboarding waves, new phones for a whole team, or after a mass reset of MFA.
Help.BulkTap.Need: A CSV with a UPN column (or one UPN per line) or an Entra group. TAP must be enabled in the tenant.
Help.BulkTap.Steps:
1. Choose CSV or group.
2. Set lifetime and single use.
3. "Check" resolves the users.
4. "Create" creates the passes (existing ones are replaced).
5. "Excel export" saves the list for handing out.
Help.BulkTap.Result: The passes are only in the window and in the export – never in the log. Store the Excel file safely and delete it after handing out.
Help.Report.Title: MFA report
Help.Report.What: Rates the MFA status of all users (or of a group) as a traffic light, with roles, methods and last sign-in.
Help.Report.When: For audits, before enforcing MFA, or to find administrators without phishing-resistant MFA.
Help.Report.Need: Nothing extra – the last sign-in requires Entra ID P1/P2, otherwise the column stays empty.
Help.Report.Steps:
1. Choose all users or a group, optionally guests and disabled accounts.
2. "Create report".
3. Click a tile to filter by color, search in the list.
4. Double-click a user to open them in the main window.
Help.Report.Result: Red = no MFA or admin without proper MFA, yellow = weak MFA, green = strong. "Excel export" saves the filtered list in traffic light colors.
Help.Offboard.Title: Bulk offboarding
Help.Offboard.What: Removes all MFA methods of many users, revokes their sessions and can disable the accounts.
Help.Offboard.When: Leavers, a compromised account wave, or when devices of a whole team were lost.
Help.Offboard.Need: A CSV with UPNs or an Entra group. Your own account is always skipped.
Help.Offboard.Steps:
1. Choose CSV or group and the actions.
2. "Check" shows how many methods and roles every user has.
3. "Run offboarding" – you confirm the summary first.
Help.Offboard.Result: Every line shows what was done. "Excel export" saves the list as evidence. Removed methods cannot be restored – the users register them again (e.g. with a TAP).
Help.BreakGlass.Title: Break-glass account
Help.BreakGlass.What: Creates an emergency access account with Global Administrator and a FIDO2 key.
Help.BreakGlass.When: Once per tenant (better: two) – so you still get in when Conditional Access or MFA locks everybody out.
Help.BreakGlass.Need: A FIDO2 key for the account and Privileged Role Administrator / Global Administrator rights.
Help.BreakGlass.Steps:
1. Choose the domain (.onmicrosoft.com is recommended).
2. Enter the key's serial number.
3. "Create" – plug in the key when Windows asks.
4. Afterwards: exclude the account from all CA policies ("Check CA exclusion" in the main window).

Help.Campaign.Title: MFA campaign
Help.Campaign.What: Sends the MFA setup guide to many users at once – by email and/or as a Teams message – and shows who was contacted how often, when and through which channel. The second tab classifies accounts as person / not a person.
Help.Campaign.When: When rolling out MFA: first classify the accounts together with the customer, then send the guide to everybody without proper MFA, and remind those who still have not set it up a week later.
Help.Campaign.Need: Email: a sender mailbox (own or shared with Send As). Teams: Teams for you and the user; the message comes from your account. If the MFA report was created in this session, its data is used.
Help.Campaign.Steps:
1. "Load users" (or use the data of the MFA report).
2. Tab "Classify accounts": mark shared mailboxes and service accounts as "Not a person".
3. Tab "Campaign": filter (e.g. red and yellow, never contacted), select users or "Select all".
4. Choose email and/or Teams and click "Send guide".
5. Later: filter "Not contacted for 7 days" and send a reminder.
Help.Campaign.Result: Every sending is stored on the user (count, first and last date, last 20 sendings with channel and sender). "Result" shows what happened per user; "Excel export" saves the list.
